notes.title: PROTOTYPE Update: Enhanced Animations, Expanded Languages, and Improved Audio
notes.content:
[ GAMEPLAY ]

Introduced new idle animations for the Laser Robot and Close Combat Robot, enhancing the visual appeal and character depth.
Added dynamic new idle animations for Bosses in Level 3 and Level 6, offering a more immersive and engaging player experience.
Implemented visual feedback for taking damage, providing clearer and more immediate player response to in-game actions.
Integrated a new sound effect when picking up powerups, enriching the audio experience and player feedback.
[ LOCALIZATION ]

Expanded language support to include Chinese, Polish, Swedish, Korean, and Japanese, broadening the game's global reach.
Added subtitles and localized UI elements for the newly supported languages, ensuring a more accessible and user-friendly experience for a diverse player base.
[ MISC ]

Fixed timing issues with sound effects in Boss Level 6, ensuring a more synchronized and immersive audio experience.
Enhanced overall game stability and performance through various minor bug fixes and optimizations.
[ AUDIO ]

Refined audio cues and background scores for an enriched auditory experience, complementing the game's visual enhancements.

notes.title: Patch 16/10/2023
notes.content:
[ GAMEPLAY ]
- Boss Level 6: Fixed a critical issue where players could bypass and finish the level without defeating the boss. Players now need to defeat the boss to proceed.
- Level 5: Resolved a bug where drones remained undestroyed upon collision with the ground, causing players to be trapped indefinitely in the level. Drones will now correctly be destroyed upon impact.

[ ACHIEVEMENTS ]
- Achievement "Truth Seeker": Rectified an issue where the achievement was unavailable for players. It is now attainable once more.

[ USER INTERFACE ]
- Lobby Level 1: Addressed an oversight where the level remained locked for players. It is now unlocked by default for all users.

You won't be alone, though. Power-ups will materialize around the battlefield, providing you with essential aid in your battle for survival.

Get ready to dive into the Cyberscape and test your skills ahead of the full game release.
